title: era_test_catalog overwrites (and leaks) test_catalog's newly-added era table — the fixture's era rows are now built in two places
evidence: core/era_test.odin:32 (era_test_catalog): `cat.eras = make([dynamic]Era_Row, 0, 4, allocator)` — and core/determinism_test.odin:164 (test_catalog, the W6 fold): `cat.eras = make([dynamic]Era_Row, 0, 4, allocator)` followed by `make_era_row(cat, 1, "foundations", "Foundations (ARPANET)", 1, {ei2}, {res2, rt2}, {na2, std2}, allocator)` … `make_era_row(cat, 3, "streaming_surge", "The Streaming Surge", 3, {ei2, si2}, {res2, rt2, sb2, ch2, cp2, rm2, rh2}, {na2, std2, wd2}, allocator)`. catalogs_destroy frees only the CURRENT table (`delete(cat.eras)`), so every test calling test_catalog then era_test_catalog (all 6 era_test tests + the advance_gate tests) leaks the first table. Empirically confirmed via `odin test core`: `+++ leak       672B @ 0x4C38009A0 [determinism_test.odin:164:test_catalog()]` (plus _proclit row-literal leaks) on core.test_advance_gate_fires_when_conditions_hold / _scripted_request_still_gated / _era_advance_disabled_keeps_61_mechanics, etc.
detail: The W6 fold made the shared fixture build era rows 1-3; era_test_catalog then re-makes cat.eras without freeing them — a per-test leak plus a duplicated era-table construction (rows 1-3, already drifting cosmetically: 'Foundations' vs 'Foundations (ARPANET)') that must be kept in sync by hand.
recommended_fix: In era_test_catalog, free the existing rows before re-making (delete each row's packet_classes/unlock_node_types/unlock_pipe_tiers + cat.eras), or have it reuse test_catalog's table and only append the era-4 row.

title: `advance gate on` lacks the era>=1 parse-time guard that `growth on` has — an era-0 gate demo blesses a vacuous golden and fails drift-check with a misleading message
evidence: harness/demo.odin:590 (the advance case) ends with just `d.advance_gate_on = true` — while the growth directive has a parse-time inertness guard (demo.odin:616-618): `if d.growth_on && d.era == 0 {` / `return {}, "growth on requires an era >= 1 (era 0 is the legacy director-inactive mode — growth would be inert and bless a no-growth golden)"`. era_step's gate branch confirms era 0 is inert: `if state.era == 0 || int(state.era) >= len(cat.eras) { return }` (core/era.odin:277).
detail: A future demo with `advance gate on` but no `era` line (default 0) would silently bless a gate-inert golden at `harness save`, then drift-check's advance_gate_flip fails CI red with the wrong diagnosis ('gate is not replay-determinate') instead of an authoring error.
recommended_fix: Mirror the growth guard at the end of parse_demo: `if d.advance_gate_on && d.era == 0 { return {}, "advance gate on requires an era >= 1 (the gate is inert in era 0)" }`.
